title: Measure Chain
description: Add and take away measures in one unit, carry a written answer into the next step, total a list of parts two ways, and pour water in litres.
modes: none. One flow, one phase at a time. The host mounts a phase (phase prop). With navigableDots true, or no phase, the child may jump phases with the dots (user mode); otherwise the dots show progress and the teacher agent drives window.toolApi (AI mode). The last phase, and a whole lesson, end on the summary page, where Free play and Play again sit. With navDots the dots are controls in AI mode too: a tap on a dot starts that phase.

stage.sizing: the frame is min(100vw, 177.78vh) wide and min(100vh, 56.25vw) tall (dvh where supported); the svg fills it. Nothing scrolls.

bands.header: 0 to 80. One line: the tool name, a measured dot, the phase concept; Hint, sound and restart as round controls far right.
bands.canvas: 92 to 640. One rounded card holding the key at its top right (Answer, Close, Enter, Next, or the Yes / No keys; no question bar), the working area (the whole card until Answer is tapped) and the answer drawer that slides in from the right; the summary page covers it at the end.
bands.footer: 652 to 900. The mascot at the far left on its ground line, the speech bubble beside it (y 656 to 892, the question and every line, printed), one small dot per phase at the right.

zones.layout: board, key only: no question bar, only its key at the right end of the top row (the question is on the bubble); the working area is the whole card (64, 108, 1472 x 520) until the child taps Answer, when the answer drawer (as tall as the working area, the key on its top row reading Close) slides in from the right
zones.controls: circles r 28 at cx 1388, 1460, 1532, cy 40: Hint (data-control again), sound, restart; 72-unit finger boxes
zones.dots: one small dot per phase at the footer's right (72-unit finger boxes, centred on the bubble), no text; in user AND AI mode each is a button (data-control phase-dot, data-phase k) that starts its phase

stage.noSidebar: There is no sidebar. The canvas takes every unit the chrome can spare.
stage.noScoreBox: There is no score box on the stage. The score leaves on finished and onComplete and is shown once, as stars on the summary page.

writeup.why: Add and subtract measures in one unit, carrying each answer into the next step, and list the parts of a plan with their measures and find and check the total.
writeup.look: One measuring scene at a time, a tape, a scale or a jug, with a column strip at the right writing each step, an Answer card on the second phase and a List panel on the third.
writeup.stage: Three bands across 1600 by 900. The header runs 0 to 80 and is one line only: 'Measure Chain' in ink at the far left, a small dot set clear of the name, the phase title beside the dot on the same line, the host's navigation, and sound and restart as three round controls at the far right. The canvas runs 92 to 746, one rounded card on the paper colour. At its top left, at x sixty-four, y 108 and 330 by 76, sits the running count: how many steps have been written in the column strip. It is never a score. The working area is 1086 by 528 at x sixty-four, y 202. The scene fills the left of the working area from x 110 to x 760. The tape runs along y 520, 640 long, marked in metres and tenths, with rope pieces above it at y 440, each tagged with its measure and unit in deep blue. The scale stands at x 300, y 300 with its dial reading kilograms. The jug is 200 wide and 360 tall at x 330, y 250, marked in tenths of a litre with a long line at each whole litre; water poured out fades rose, labelled Taken away, and the water left is green, labelled Left. The column strip runs down the right of the working area at x 820, 300 wide, one step per row with the points in one line and each result green. On the second phase the Answer card sits at x 820, y 560 and is dragged up into the next row. On the third the List panel replaces the scene, one line per part, with the Total and Check totals side by side under it. Down the right of the canvas, in the same rectangle on every phase and never animated in or out, the question sits above the answer slot at x 1186, y 250 (356 by 92) that holds what the child has given, and under it the pad at x 1170, y 368 (388 by 363). The pad is twelve number keys three across with a point key and a row of unit keys, m, km, kg and L, for setting a measure or typing an answer with its unit into the answer slot. The footer runs 758 to 900: the voice caption at the far left with its speaking dot beside it, measuring its own wrap and dropping a type size rather than spilling, and the phase bar at the right with the question count under it. There is no sidebar and no score box anywhere, and nothing is ever written over the working area. Content colours are the chapter's own, and the tools of this chapter share them. A decimal or fraction the question gives is deep blue, with the shaded parts that show it. The result the working reaches, a decimal, a fraction, a sum, a difference or what is left, is green, with its shaded parts. Ten of one place traded for one of the next, a carry in adding or a trade in taking away, is vermilion. A zero written after the point to line decimals up is violet, and so is the point written after a whole number before those zeros. The part taken away, used or poured out is rose. The digit, place or step being worked on now, and the first place where two decimals differ, are amber. A zero holding a place open inside a number is grey, and nothing else on the stage is ever grey. An unshaded part stays warm white inside its near-black outline, the decimal point is near-black ink, and anything dimmed fades to half strength rather than turning grey. Chrome never borrows one of them, and each of those readings survives with the colour taken away, because a part is told by its written label, Given, Answer, Carry, Trade, Added zero, Taken away, Left or Place holder, before it is told by its colour.
writeup.finish: The card shows the last scene with every step written in the strip, each answer carried to the next.

writeup.delight: On the fourth phase, as water pours out of the jug, the level slides down past the tenths marks one by one with a soft glug for each, and the reading in the strip ticks down with it.
writeup.opening: Every mount comes up already furnished for its phase with its measuring scene set out and nothing joined, weighed or poured. On the first phase rope pieces lie above the tape. On the second a bag sits on the scale with scoops beside it and the Answer card empty. On the third the List panel holds its parts with both totals blank. On the fourth the jug stands with water in it and a cup and a bottle beside it. One thing moves, once: the first rope piece, scoop, list line or cup gives one slow pulse while the voice speaks its opening line, and a finger on it is the whole way in.
writeup.freePlay: Any rope pieces, bags or water, joined, weighed or poured, with the Answer card and the List panel. Nothing to get right, no target and no timer. The child is left with the same stage and every control unlocked.
writeup.practice: Eight items over the four phases, easy first, on measures in one unit, two-step chains, lists with totals, and water in litres.

onWrong.marks: Nothing is marked, nothing resets, no colour means good or bad. The child's answer stays; the pad re-opens after the traceback.
tracebacks: Phase 1: every piece is joined and every measure written with two places, then the column is added from the right, carries and all, to the green total with its unit
Phase 2: the two parts are added on the Answer card, the card is carried into step 2, and the take away runs from the right to the green amount left
Phase 3: the list is written in both orders and each column is added from the right to the green total, the two the same
Phase 4: every pour is made, each step written in litres, and the last column is worked from the right to the green reading

voice.opening: Measures waiting to be joined, weighed or poured.
voice.onFreePlay: Free play. Join rope, weigh bags or pour water.
voice.onMiss: the item's own miss line, then the phase's two ladder rungs, shown at once UNDER the pinned instruction and kept until the child acts again
voice.onFinish: One unit, one step at a time, every answer written down.
voice.rules: Silent: nothing is spoken (no device speech, no recorded clips, no Tap to start cover). The speech bubble is the guide: every instruction and hint is one printed page, numbers as words. The lesson is action-driven in every mode: a guide step's instruction stays until the child does the act it names; a wrong act shows that step's hint under the pinned instruction, a wrong answer the next rung of its ladder, and the hint stays unchanged until the child acts again; a right answer's next question, a phase's next phase and the summary's rows follow by themselves after a short celebration. The header's Hint key shows the step's hint or the next rung on demand. What is heard is sound effects (Web Audio), switched by the sound button, on in every mode. In classroom mode nothing waits for a tap except the pieces of a long line (the blinking arrow; a tap, Enter, Space, ArrowRight or PageDown on the bubble shows the next piece), and a tap on the bubble when nothing waits is the teacher's skip.

guide.playsOn: guide steps on phase 1, 2, 3, 4: the phase opens on its first instruction and waits for the child's act (getState guideStep, guideSteps, guideOn); the agent's check() performs the current step; the last act opens the first question. Other phases open on their printed teach lines, and a demo phase waits for the child's own act.

palette.rule: A content colour fills countable things only and chrome never borrows one; coloured numerals and words take a deeper ink of their colour (4.5:1).

scoring.wrong: costs nothing, never marked, counted only for first try accuracy
scoring.stars: one for finishing, two at sixty per cent right first time, three at ninety; hidden with the first-try line by showScore false
scoring.phaseMount: a mount scores every phase it plays, from its phase to the last (+5 a question; phases of 3, 3, 3, 3 questions)
scoring.finishCard: stars and the Right first time line under the phase rows on the summary page

hostContract.phase: absent (not a finite number): the whole lesson, phases one to 4 in a row, the summary page at the end, finished once. Present: rounded and clamped to one to 4; the tool starts at that phase and, as the NCERT tools do, walks on by itself after each phase's last question (its closing line, then 1.4 s), in user and AI mode alike, through phase 4 to the summary page (a tool with nextKey, runtime r48+: in user mode it waits for the child's blinking Next key instead, after every question and every phase, and the last phase's key opens the summary; AI mode, and a host that mounts one phase without navigableDots, walk on by themselves); finished once, from the summary page.
hostContract.navigableDots: true (or no phase): user mode, the phase dots are controls; otherwise AI mode, the dots show progress and the agent drives window.toolApi.

hostContract.emits: every event is dispatched on window and, when framed, posted to window.parent as { type: 'event', name, detail }
